Metamorphosis permanently holds a mostly gaseous but aware subject in a container, unable to attack or use abilities and without bodily needs or aging, reducing DC by 4. Minimus Containment permanently shrinks the subject to 1 inch or less inside a gem, jar, or similar object, also without bodily needs or aging, reducing DC by 4. Limited-duration bindings can overlap, with a save when the first expires that can break all. Dispel magic cannot end binding, though antimagic field and Mordenkainen's disjunction affect it; a bound extraplanar creature cannot be dismissed or banished. spells/dispel-possession-1330.name: Dispel Possession

spells/dispel-taint-2014.name: Dispel Taint

spells/dispel-ward-4393.name: Dispel Ward

spells/dispel-water-3121.name: Dispel Water
spells/dispel-water-3121.effectSummary: Choose one of three effects; instantaneous water effects cannot be countered. Dry Up Water destroys 200 cubic feet of water per caster level. If at least 1,000 cubic feet vanish from a large body, the resulting current requires a DC 20 Swim check or pulls a creature down 10 feet per caster level, forcing it to hold its breath or begin drowning; vessels capsize 95% of the time if under 20 feet long, 50% at 20–60 feet, and 20% if over 60 feet. Counterspell mode works only against water-descriptor spells, Water-domain spells, or effects clearly involving water and requires a dispel check of 1d20 + caster level, maximum +20, against DC 11 + the spell's caster level. Dismiss Water Creature targets one extraplanar water-subtype creature; Will negates and spell resistance applies, otherwise it is sent to its home plane.

provenance.role: primary DnD Tools effect text reviewed and paraphrased for all three modes, current/capsize rules, dispel check, and dismissal save

spells/dispelling-breath-4394.name: Dispelling Breath
spells/dispelling-breath-4394.effectSummary: Requires a breath weapon. Creatures or objects that fail their save against that breath are subject to a dispel sequence before the breath's normal effect resolves: make 1d20 + caster level, maximum +15, against DC 11 + the highest-caster-level spell affecting the target, then try progressively weaker spells until one is dispelled or all checks fail. Magic items are unaffected. A failed-save creature created by an ongoing conjuration can also have that creating spell dispelled, and each ongoing area or effect spell centered in the breath area receives a dispel check. You may automatically succeed against your own spells. Targets that save against the breath are not dispelled.

provenance.role: primary DnD Tools effect text reviewed and paraphrased for the Spell Compendium printing; its one-spell-per-target progression and pre-breath resolution order are preserved

spells/dispelling-breath-998.name: Dispelling Breath
spells/dispelling-breath-998.effectSummary: The breath weapon produced with this casting also dispels magic from creatures and objects that fail their save against the breath. For each such target, make a separate dispel check against every ongoing spell affecting it: 1d20 + caster level, maximum +15, against DC 11 + that spell's caster level. Magic items and targets that save against the breath are unaffected by the dispelling. You can also dispel the ongoing spell that created a failed-save summoned or conjured creature, and make checks against each ongoing area or effect spell centered inside the breath area. You may automatically succeed against your own spells. Unlike the later Spell Compendium printing, this version checks every ongoing spell on each failed-save target rather than stopping after one successful dispel.

provenance.role: primary DnD Tools effect text reviewed and paraphrased for the Draconomicon printing; its check-against-every-spell behavior is preserved

spells/dispelling-screen-4395.name: Dispelling Screen
spells/dispelling-screen-4395.effectSummary: Creates an immobile screen that applies a targeted dispel to spell effects operating on any creature or unattended object that passes through it. Attended magic items are not affected. For spell effects, make 1d20 + caster level, maximum +10, against DC 11 + the effect's caster level. For an unattended magic object, the same check suppresses its magical properties for 1d4 rounds against a DC equal to the item's caster level. Spell effects not operating on creatures or objects cannot pass through the screen. Disintegrate or a successful dispel magic destroys the screen, while antimagic field suppresses it. The material component is a sheet of fine lead crystal.

provenance.role: primary DnD Tools effect text reviewed and paraphrased for crossing behavior, item exception, check/DC distinctions, and screen removal

spells/dispelling-touch-2909.name: Dispelling Touch

Magic items carried by a creature are not affected.

provenance.role: primary DnD Tools effect text reviewed and paraphrased for progressive targeted dispel mechanics

spells/displacement-2667.name: Displacement
spells/displacement-2667.effectSummary: The subject appears about 2 feet from its true position and gains a 50% miss chance as though it had total concealment. provenance.role: primary DnD Tools effect text reviewed and paraphrased for miss chance, targeting exception, true seeing, and component

spells/displacer-form-4397.name: Displacer Form
spells/displacer-form-4397.effectSummary: You become a Large magical beast resembling a displacer beast. Your space/reach becomes 15 feet/5 feet, with 10-foot tentacle reach; you gain two tentacle attacks for 1d6 + Strength each, Str 18, Dex 15, Con 16, land speed 40 feet, darkvision 60 feet, low-light vision, and +5 natural armor, while retaining your mental scores, class and level, hit points, alignment, base attack bonus, and base saves. You lose your form's spell-like abilities and non-class-derived extraordinary abilities, retain supernatural abilities and class-derived extraordinary special attacks, and can still speak and cast spells if you can physically touch required material components. You gain the displacer beast's displacement—50% miss chance against melee and ranged attacks unless located without sight, defeated by true seeing but not see invisibility—and +2 resistance on saves against targeted ranged spells or magical attacks except ranged touch attacks. Equipment melds into the form and becomes nonfunctional. The material component is a displacer-beast claw.

spells/disquietude-4398.name: Disquietude

spells/disrupt-undead-greater-4399.name: Disrupt Undead, Greater

spells/dissonant-chant-3189.name: Dissonant Chant
spells/dissonant-chant-3189.effectSummary: Affected creatures attempting spellcasting or another activity that requires concentration must make a Concentration check; this Savage Species printing defines the basic check as DC 18 + the relevant Intelligence or Charisma modifier for wizard or sorcerer casting. spells/dissonant-chant-4400.name: Dissonant Chant

spells/dissonant-chord-4401.name: Dissonant Chord

spells/distilled-joy-105.name: Distilled Joy

spells/distort-weapon-242.name: Distort Weapon

spells/distract-4403.name: Distract

spells/distracting-shadows-4836.name: Distracting Shadows

spells/divest-essentia-1834.name: Divest Essentia

spells/divination-3543.name: Divination
spells/divination-3543.effectSummary: Ask about a specific goal, event, or activity expected within one week and receive a useful piece of advice, possibly direct or cryptic; the DM controls the information and changed circumstances can make it obsolete. spells/divine-agility-742.name: Divine Agility

spells/divine-interdiction-4408.name: Divine Interdiction

spells/divine-retaliation-2971.name: Divine Retaliation
spells/divine-retaliation-2971.effectSummary: Creates a force weapon resembling your deity's favored weapon that shares your space. spells/divine-retribution-5003.name: Divine Retribution

spells/divine-retribution-586.name: Divine Retribution

The hit point damage is always half divine power and half an energy type, and the ability damaged depends on your deity: Bahamut cold/Dex; Boccob electricity/Int; Corellon acid/Wis; Ehlonna cold/Str; Erythnul fire/Con; Fharlanghn acid/Con; Garl sonic/Wis; Gruumsh fire/Str; Heironeous electricity/Dex; Hextor fire/Str; Kord acid/Str; Kurtulmak fire/Int; Lolth electricity/Cha; Moradin sonic/Dex; Nerull cold/Cha; Obad-Hai electricity/Dex; Olidammara fire/Dex; Pelor fire/Wis; St. Cuthbert sonic/Con; Tiamat fire/Wis; Vecna cold/Int; Wee Jas cold/Str; Yondalla acid/Str. A successful Will save halves the hit point damage and negates the ability damage. A caster without a deity permanently chooses an eligible deity within one alignment step on the first casting, changing only if later alignment changes make that choice invalid. Only one Divine Retribution can be active at a time.

provenance.role: primary DnD Tools effect text and deity/energy/ability table reviewed and paraphrased for the Complete Champion printing; its trigger, damage split, save, and deity mapping are preserved separately

spells/divine-sacrifice-4410.name: Divine Sacrifice

spells/dominate-person-2547.name: Dominate Person

The subject pursues its current command except for ordinary survival needs, and a DC 15 Sense Motive check can notice the enchantment influence. Changing instructions is a move action. As a standard action you can concentrate to receive the subject's interpreted sensory impressions, but it cannot telepathically communicate back. A command against the subject's nature grants a new save at +2; obviously self-destructive orders are ignored. Once established, control has unlimited range on the same plane and does not require sight. If you fail to concentrate on the spell for at least 1 round each day, the subject gains a new save to escape. Protection from evil or similar magic suppresses control and telepathic use while present but does not prevent or dispel the domination itself.
